name: All in one kuch kuch
ingredients_raw: Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil, Cottonseed Oil), Gram Flour, Sugar, Peanuts (7%), Dew Beans Flour (Moth Flour), Split Chickpea (4%), Corn Flakes (4%), Rice Flakes (4%), Split Green Gram (3%), Whole Lentils (3%), Cashew (2%), Raisins (2%), Potato Sticks (2%), Flattened Chickpea (Chana Press) (1%), Green Peas (1%), Tapioca (0.1%), Potato Flakes, Starch (Potato, Tapioca, Corn), Sesame Seeds, Ground Spices & Condiments (Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulator (INS330), Red Chilli, Coriander, Turmeric (Coloring and Spices), Cumin, Fennel Seeds, Ginger, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Clove, Nutmeg, Spinach Powder, Asafoetida, Bishop's Seeds, Curry Leaves). Contains: Added permitted synthetic food colour (INS 133, INS 102). Contains: Peanuts, Cashew, Sesame.
